hooks.command: echo '[Claude Code] File saved. Remember to run linter! (HW grading hook)'
echo 'Please remember to run /chat-history-log before you exit!'

INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then PY=python3; for c in server/.venv/bin/python server/venv/bin/python .venv/bin/python venv/bin/python; do if [ -x "$c" ]; then PY="$PWD/$c"; break; fi; done; echo "[TDD GATE] Running backend tests before commit: cd server && $PY -m pytest -q" >&2; if (cd server && "$PY" -m pytest -q) >&2; then exit 0; else echo '[TDD GATE] Tests failed or pytest is not installed. Commit blocked.' >&2; exit 2; fi; else exit 0; fi
